status: reproduced from existing local artifacts; no new download
method: Same-person adjacent-month screen using WPFINWGT and 240 Census replicate weights with Fay BRR, perturbation factor 0.5; utility condition and tenure are measured at month t and earnings/hours movement at month t+1.
result: The v18 rerun reproduces the promoted point estimates and uncertainty profiles in us-sipp-utility-work-tenure-following-2024.json.
boundary: This is a reproduction audit, not a causal estimate. The screen does not establish a dated utility shock, tenure effect, job loss, desired-hours mismatch, household prevalence, care substitution, recovery, trust, or political action. Primary and replicate files remain outside Git.
